name: Prompt checkup
description: Intercept Mika's system prompt, rewrite it according to persona.conf and then send it to the model; it can also scan directories, read sections, apply patches and roll back.
author: Mika

tools.name: scan
tools.description: Scan a directory for files that look like system prompts or host configuration and list them by hit count. Read-only: nothing is changed.

limit.description: How many files to list at most, 1-200 (default 40)

tools.name: read_part
tools.description: Read only the first N lines of a file, so you can tell what it really is before acting.

tools.name: backup
tools.description: Copy a file into the plugin's own backup directory and return the backup path. Nothing outside the plugin directory is touched.

tools.name: patch
tools.description: Replace a piece of text literally in a file (not a regex). It backs up first; when the text is missing or the hit count does not match the expectation it refuses to write and changes nothing. Use expect to say how many places you intend to replace.

find.description: Text to find (matched literally, not as a regex)

replace.description: Replacement text; leave empty to delete

expect.description: How many hits you expect; nothing is written when the actual count differs

tools.name: restore
tools.description: Put the most recent backup of a file back. The current content is backed up first, so the rollback itself can be undone.

tools.name: apply
tools.description: Check the prompt rules and try them on a sample prompt to see what they actually produce. Read-only: nothing is changed.

model.description: Optional: which model the rules are tried for

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Reset the prompt rules to the default (all comments, which leaves the prompt unchanged). The current configuration is backed up first.

tools.name: ledger
tools.description: Record one piece of public-information evidence, or list the entries already in the ledger. Entries without an http(s) source are never accepted.

action.description: add (default, record one entry) or list (list them)

text.description: The evidence, written in one line

source.description: Source link, must be http(s), required when recording

tag.description: Optional tag, such as the subject name
